name: r5-conn-snapshot-key
description: Fix round connections (item 5): store.js listSnapshotPending selects the snapshot markers with key LIKE 'valve_snapshot_pending:%'. The gateway's sqlite3 matches a BLOB key as text; modernc is built with SQLITE_LIKE_DOESNT_MATCH_BLOBS. emitPendingSnapshots then slices the EUI off at the prefix length, upper-cases it, and claims the marker by the TEXT key 'valve_snapshot_pending:' + EUI. Each marker below is past the five-minute cap; the clock ticks send what Node-RED sends.

steps.why: Two debounced snapshots past the five-minute cap. 0840410000000021's marker key is 'VALVE_SNAPSHOT_PENDING:0840410000000021' (upper-case prefix, TEXT): it matches the LIKE, sorts first, and push.js slices the EUI off at the prefix length, then finds no 'valve_snapshot_pending:' marker for it, so nothing is sent. A840410000000023's marker is the ordinary key.
